title: Just Juice Mint Range Black Mint Saltfill Shortfill 40ml E-Liquid
description: Just Juice Black Mint Saltfill delivers a striking Menthol vape with full intensity. Icy, direct, and uncompromisingly cool, this flavour is designed for fans of powerful menthol blends that refresh with every draw. Supplied in a 60ml bottle containing 40ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, there’s room for up to two nicotine shots if required. Blended at 60PG/40VG, Just Juice Saltfills are well suited to pod kits and starter devices, producing bright flavour and a satisfying throat hit. Crafted with double-concentrated flavouring, Black Mint offers a menthol experience that stays bold and consistent all day. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
